g.text: READ example — selected channel RAM to bank_data
Example after slot 2 is complete: rd_channel=2 (C), rd_slot=2, rd_row=1, read_fire=1.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1494px; height: 1px; padding-top: 106px; margin-left: 9px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 18px; font-family: Arial; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Only channel C reads. All eight lanes in C use the same address:
address = rd_slot * ROWS + rd_row = 2 * 128 + 1 = 257
At that address, lane L contains sample C(8 + L). The A, B and D banks are not read.

switch.text: Only channel C reads. All eight lanes in C use the same address:...

g.text: Channel C — banks_gen(2) / lanes_gen(0..7); physical slots are address regions within each lane RAM.

g.text: On the rd_clk edge with read_fire=1: ram_read_proc registers the eight lane outputs into bank_data(2).
On the next rd_clk edge: packing_proc selects bank_data(rd_channel) and registers packed_data.
IQ16 preserves 256 bits; IQ12 retains the upper 12 bits of each I/Q component, producing 192 useful bits.
Synchronous readout only accesses completed, reader-owned slots; ownership is coordinated by the external HostTCDRX FIFOs.
